title: Usage Insights: CSV export (async jobs, signed downloads, audit events, limits)
creator: Dylan Brooks
description:
Build the CSV export feature for Usage Insights route+model breakdowns.

This ticket covers:
- Server-side export generation (async job) for breakdown tables
- Signed download URLs (short-lived)
- Audit events for export creation + download
- Throttling and limits (row caps, time range guardrails)
- RBAC gating for cost/export

Motivation
Customers (eng leads, finance/FinOps) need to pull route/model cost + usage into BI tools and for internal chargeback. Export totals must match billing breakdown totals for the same filters (within tolerance defined by ENG-3817).

Scope / Requirements
1) API surface (owned by usage insights query service)
- POST /v1/usage-insights/exports
  - creates an async export job for a given query (time range, workspace/project, route, model, region/deployment mode where supported)
  - returns export_job_id
- GET /v1/usage-insights/exports/{export_job_id}
  - returns status: queued|running|complete|failed|expired
  - when complete: provides signed_download_url + expires_at
- Optional: GET /v1/usage-insights/exports/{export_job_id}/download is intentionally NOT implemented (download is via signed URL to object store)

2) Export format
- CSV columns aligned with working spec in Drive:
  - time_bucket_start (UTC)
  - workspace_id, project_id
  - route (normalized)
  - model_family, model_version (bucketed), model (display)
  - deployment_mode, region (if present in dataset)
  - requests
  - tokens_in, tokens_out
  - cache_hit_tokens, cache_miss_tokens
  - retries, fallbacks
  - latency_ms_p50, latency_ms_p95 (if available in aggregation)
  - cost_usd (rounded policy below)
- Rounding:
  - cost_usd: round to 6 decimal places in CSV to reduce reconciliation drift, keep totals stable vs billing exports
  - token counts: integers

3) Signed downloads
- URL TTL: 15 minutes (configurable)
- Object TTL/retention: 7 days from completion (auto-expire)
- File naming: usage-insights_{workspaceSlug}_{YYYY-MM-DD}_{YYYY-MM-DD}_{export_job_id}.csv

4) Permissions / RBAC
- Must require cost-view permission (ENG-3820):
  - If workspace has "Hide cost" enabled, exports are disallowed even if user can view usage (explicit deny)
  - Only roles with billing/cost visibility can create or download export
- Error responses must be explicit and safe:
  - 403 with reason: COST_ACCESS_REQUIRED or EXPORT_DISABLED_BY_WORKSPACE

5) Audit logging
Emit audit events for:
- usage_insights.export.created
  - actor_user_id
  - workspace_id / project_id
  - filters hash (not raw prompt/PII; include normalized route/model, time range, region, deployment mode)
  - export_job_id
  - estimated_row_count (if available)
- usage_insights.export.downloaded
  - actor_user_id
  - workspace_id
  - export_job_id
  - file_size_bytes
  - ip_address (if available via gateway)

6) Throttling / Limits
- Per-workspace export creation rate limit: 5 exports / hour (burst 2)
- Hard cap on max rows: 250k rows; if exceeded, fail with "EXPORT_TOO_LARGE" and suggest shorter range / more filters
- Hard cap on time range for export: 31 days (aligned with known query timeout issues; see SUP-24863)
- Concurrency: 1 running export per workspace (queue additional)

Non-goals
- Scheduled exports / email delivery
- PDF reports
- Arbitrary customer-defined columns

Implementation notes
- Export jobs stored in Postgres (console backend) with states and timestamps; payload stores query parameters (validated + normalized) and output location key.
- Export generation runs in a worker (same job runner used by billing reconciliation tasks) and reads from the aggregated dataset produced by ENG-3812.
- CSV is written to object storage (internal bucket) with server-side encryption.
- Signed URL generation delegated to storage wrapper; ensure URLs are single-use friendly but not enforced as single-use at storage layer.
- Add structured logs and metrics:
  - export_job_created_total, export_job_completed_total, export_job_failed_total
  - export_job_duration_seconds (p50/p95)
  - export_rows_written

Acceptance criteria
- [x] User with cost access can create export and download within 15 minutes of completion.
- [x] User without cost access cannot create export; returns 403 w/ explicit reason.
- [x] Workspace with Hide Cost enabled blocks export, regardless of user role.
- [x] Download emits audit event with export_job_id and file size.
- [x] Limits enforced: >31 days fails fast; >250k rows fails with guidance.
- [x] Export totals match console totals for same filters (validated via ENG-3817 fixtures; within tolerance).
- [x] Supports OpenAI-compat routes after normalization (ENG-3813) without exploding cardinality.

- API contract: sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/api-standards/usage-insights-api-contract.json
- Security/retention controls: sources/confluence/security-and-compliance/data-residency-and-retention/usage-insights-retention-and-export-controls.json
- CSV format working spec: sources/google_drive/shared_drives/engineering/console-and-tooling/export-format-csv-spec-working.json

Notes / Decisions
- We chose async exports to avoid console request timeouts for large workspaces and to allow strict throttling.
- We store only a hash of the full filter payload in audit logs to reduce accidental leakage; the full validated payload remains in the export job record with standard retention.
- Signed URL TTL is short (15m) to satisfy security requirements from Marcus/Kevin; users can re-request the job status to get a new URL while the object is retained.

Known issues / Follow-ups
- Model alias duplication risk if model bucketing is inconsistent across aggregation vs query layer; tracked in ENG-3823 and known support report SUP-24844.
- For some regions, route tags for streaming endpoints were missing earlier in the month; exports from those periods may show route = "unknown" (see ENG-3822 + Slack eng-platform 1738527701).
